core.title: Flower Knob Backplate, RK International BP-482

text.description_html:
RK International BP-482, Fancy Flower Cabinet Knob Rosette

The floral design of this RK International cabinet rose is understated, ensuring that it is not too feminine. It is available in oil rubbed bronze, satin nickel, and polished brass finishes. The Flower Knob Backplate has a 1-1/2 inch diameter and is just ornate enough to add a point of interest to any kitchen cabinet. It can be used with most cabinet knobs, but we like it best with the matching Flower Cabinet Knob or behind something more simple to jazz it up like a Half-Round Cabinet Knob. No matter which knob you choose to go with it, this flower knob backplate is sure to add beauty to it.

Use with matching CP-182 Flower Cabinet Knob

Specifications and Features of the RK International BP-482 Fancy Floral Cabinet Knob Rosette:

  • Material: Brass
  • Diameter: 1-1/2"
  • Width: 1-1/2"
  • Projection: 1/4"

Sold Individually
